T: Every big event needs a bloke like Kenny.
D: A mockumentary following a cheerful Melbourne bloke who runs portable toilets for big events.
P: Serve the mains when Kenny works the Melbourne Cup.
S: Smoked salmon blinis, shrimp cocktail shots and prosciutto-wrapped asparagus
Smoked salmon on warm blinis with crème fraîche, cooked prawns in shot glasses with a little Marie Rose sauce, and asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto.
Splashdown pork and apple sausage rolls
the footy crowds Kenny's Splashdown crew works

Pork mince with grated apple, sage and a kick of chilli rolled in flaky puff, fennel seed on top, baked golden with smoky tomato relish. Mix 600g pork mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, chopped sage, half a teaspoon of chilli flakes, 40g breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Halve 3 sheets of puff pastry, pipe a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal. Cut each into 4, brush with egg and scatter with fennel seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with smoky tomato relish.
Twice-fried fries tossed in chicken salt, hot gravy for dipping

Thick chips double fried at 140C then 190C, tossed in chicken salt, with gravy for dipping. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes until soft, then drain and rest. Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Toss in chicken salt and serve with a cup of hot gravy for dipping.
M: his trip to the convention in Nashville

Buttermilk-brined chicken thighs fried crunchy and painted with a cayenne and brown sugar chilli oil, on white bread with dill pickles and slaw. Soak 1kg chicken thigh fillets in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce and salt for 4 hours. Dredge in 250g plain flour seasoned with salt, pepper and paprika, dip back in the buttermilk, then dredge again. Fry at 165C for 7 to 8 minutes until cooked. Whisk 2 tbsp cayenne, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp paprika into 120ml of the hot frying oil and brush over. Serve on white bread with pickles and coleslaw.
Grilled rosemary lamb chops, mashed potatoes, peas and pan gravy
Lamb loin chops rubbed with rosemary, garlic and salt, grilled hot for 3 minutes a side and rested, with buttery mashed potato, peas and a proper gravy from the pan juices.
W: Crisp puff pastry layers with set vanilla custard and passionfruit icing
Two sheets of puff pastry baked flat between trays, a thick custard of milk, eggs, sugar and cornflour poured between them, set overnight, topped with passionfruit icing and cut with a hot knife.
K: Lager over lime, tomato juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce, chili salt rim

Cold Aussie lager poured over lime, tomato juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce in a chilli salt rimmed glass, plenty of ice and a lime wedge. Mix 1 tbsp sea salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of 4 pot glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Into each glass put ice, 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, a dash of Worcestershire and 3 drops of hot sauce. Top slowly with cold lager, stir once and add a lime wedge.
